explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1182: 'It is trivial … that R(K_3,G) ≥ 2n−1 for any connected graph G on n vertices.' The Lean statement: for connected G on Fin n, 2n − 1 ≤ graphRamsey K_3 G. Correct (two disjoint copies of K_{n−1} in the second colour give a colouring of K_{2n−2} with no first-colour triangle and no connected n-vertex graph in the second colour); connectivity forces n ≥ 1 so the truncated subtraction is exact. Faithful.
